comment: The pinned test check fails only because it runs the deleted test:fast; ignore that. Real rework after merging main (a39ba10) into the story: `bun run test` has 5 failures. (1) packages/cli/test/story-reset.test.ts (new on main) is not in a tier folder (B14) and imports ./harness.ts, which slice 03 moved: put it in the right tier (it uses the cli harness, so integration) and fix its imports. (2) test/repo/repo.test.ts: the #125 ci-check tests call chmodSync, which the merge dropped from the imports: restore the import. Then run `bun run test`, `bun run test:integration` and `bun run typecheck`, all green, and report done.
